_comment: Every third-party asset pack vendored into this repo, and the licence file
that covers it. `licence` is the file in this folder — copied verbatim from
the pack as downloaded, never written by hand. Entries with licence:null are
NOT cleared: the pack ships in the build but its licence file has never been

A pack may instead carry `evidence`: a file that records the author's permission in plain words but is NOT a formal licence grant (no named licence, no public-domain dedication). That is better than nothing and worse than a licence — such packs stay PENDING, with the file on record.
seen on disk, so its status rests on the creator's website alone.
tools/check-licences.mjs enforces that every directory under assets/ is
claimed here, and reports the pending ones.

packs.states: Generated for this project; no third-party rights.

NOT a formal licence. The pack's own readme says verbatim: "As explained in the itch.io page, credits are not mandatory, so feel free to use it in any way you want." That is a broad permission from the author, but it is not a CC0 dedication and it defers to the itch.io page, which could not be read (network blocked).
packs.note: EIGHT OF THE TEN TRACKS IN THE SHIPPING GAME. Established 2026-08-07 by md5-matching every file in assets/audio/music against the pack in the game-assets repo: boss-intro/loop = '09. Battle Theme II', causeway+kiln = '15. Volcanic Crater', den+ember-calm = '04. Peaceful Village', region-stone = '06. Hidden Cavern', stone-deep = '10. Dwarven Mine'. CREDITS.md had described this pack as an unused bonus for future regions. (v3.21.2: ember-calm.ogg and kiln.mp3 were byte-identical duplicates of den.ogg and causeway.mp3 and were deleted — those two names are now aliases in js/audio.js, so the same eight HydroGene tracks still cover ten music cues.)
packs.acceptedNote: Shipping under the private-family-use decision recorded in .distribution. Nothing about the licence itself has changed or been verified — the FIX line above is still what would clear it.

packs.pack: OpenGameArt — Cave Theme (Brandon Morris) + Victory Fanfare Short (cynicmusic)
packs.states: UNVERIFIED — per-submission licences on opengameart.org, which this environment cannot reach.
packs.note: The only two tracks NOT from HydroGene, confirmed by md5 against both the HydroGene pack and every Kenney audio pack (no match). OGA hosts CC0, CC-BY and GPL side by side and licences are per submission, so each page must be checked: a CC-BY track needs visible credit in-game, a GPL track could not be used at all. NOTE: 'Boss Battle Music' by Juhani Junkala is credited in CREDITS.md but is NOT in the build — the boss music is HydroGene's Battle Theme II.
packs.acceptedNote: Shipping under the private-family-use decision recorded in .distribution. Nothing about the licence itself has changed or been verified — the FIX line above is still what would clear it.

packs.pack: Superpowers — Medieval Fantasy Asset Pack (music themes)
packs.states: CC0 1.0 Universal — the repository's own LICENSE.txt, copied verbatim; it covers every pack in sparklinlabs/superpowers-asset-packs. Assets created by Pixel-boy for Superpowers supporters (per the pack's README).
packs.note: The first music in the game with a formal licence file on disk. Six themes from medieval-fantasy/music/theme-{1..6}.ogg, renamed to the region each serves; the theme→region mapping was chosen by decoded-audio character (duration, energy, onset density, brightness) and needs a HUMAN EAR's veto — dad has final cut on all six.
